sources.title: GlucoFM: Foundation model for continuous glucose monitoring
sources.snippet: GlucoFM is a lightweight, self-supervised CGM foundation model that models slower glucose trends and short-term deviations in separate streams, producing transferable representations and setting new performance standards across diverse metabolic prediction tasks, including diabetes risk assessment, insulin resistance, beta-cell dysfunction, and post-prandial glycemic response.

sources.title: GlucoFM: A Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
sources.snippet: GlucoFM is a research prototype designed solely for retrospective physiological representation learning. GlucoFM aligns irregular recordings to a 24-hour chronological grid while preserving observation masks, and uses a dual-stream state–event encoder to separately model slow glycemic trends and transient deviations before fusion.
